original_question:
Let A ∈ GL_n(R) and let Γ ⊂ R^n be a full rank lattice. A measurable set W ⊂ R^n is an (A,Γ)-wavelet set if {W+γ}_{γ∈Γ} partitions R^n modulo null sets and {A^j W}_{j∈Z} partitions R^n modulo null sets.

Characterize pairs (A,Γ) for which an (A,Γ)-wavelet set exists.
target_in_paper: Section 3.2, Problem 3.2, read together with Definition 3.2 and the immediately preceding Problem 3.1: the paper asks for a characterization of those dilation-lattice pairs (A,Γ) for which an (A,Γ)-wavelet set exists.
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the paper's exact target. It uses the correct ambient space R^n, the correct data A ∈ GL_n(R) and a full-rank lattice Γ ⊂ R^n, the correct measurable-set notion of an (A,Γ)-wavelet set via translation and dilation partitions modulo null sets, and it asks for the same characterization problem posed in Section 3.2 as Problem 3.2.
missing_details: In the paper, this is presented as the more concrete MSF/wavelet-set version of the broader Problem 3.1, which asks for pairs (A,Γ) admitting an orthonormal wavelet.

The nearby context ties wavelet sets to MSF wavelets through the dual pair: the frequency support of an MSF wavelet associated with (A,Γ) is necessarily an (A^T,Γ^*)-wavelet set, where Γ^* is the dual lattice.

To make the question fully stand-alone, it helps to spell out what 'partitions modulo null sets' means: within each family the sets are pairwise disjoint up to null sets, and their union covers R^n up to a null set.
The surrounding discussion records the basic dilation-side obstruction: a measurable finite-measure set satisfying the dilation partition condition exists if and only if |det A| ≠ 1.

The paper also situates the question by listing the main known boundary cases: existence for every lattice when A is expansive, a complete criterion in dimension 2, and existence for almost every rotated lattice for any A with |det A| ≠ 1.
refined_question: Given n ≥ 1, an invertible real matrix A ∈ GL_n(R), and a full-rank lattice Γ ⊂ R^n, characterize exactly those pairs (A,Γ) for which there exists a measurable set W ⊂ R^n such that the translate family {W + γ : γ ∈ Γ} and the dilation family {A^j W : j ∈ Z} each partition R^n modulo null sets; that is, characterize all dilation-lattice pairs admitting an (A,Γ)-wavelet set.
justification: The draft is essentially a restatement of Section 3.2, Problem 3.2, using the paper's own Definition 3.2. The only paper-faithful context missing is that Problem 3.2 is explicitly introduced as the wavelet-set/MSF variant of Problem 3.1, motivated by the observation about frequency supports and the dual pair (A^T,Γ^*). The same nearby discussion also records the main partial results and obstructions that define the problem's intended scope: the |det A| ≠ 1 dilation-tiling obstruction, the expansive existence theorem, the complete two-dimensional criterion, and the almost-every-lattice existence result.
